newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Soccer-Vidmar's late strike downs Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Soccer-Vidmar's late strike downs Macedonia.

text.p: Striker Aurelio Vidmar scored a last-minute goal to give Australia a 1-0 win in an away friendly against the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia and maintained Terry Venables' perfect start as national team coach.
Team captain Vidmar, who plays for Tenerife in the Spanish first division, headed the winner in the 89th minute in Skopje on Wednesday night.
It was Venables' fourth success in as many matches since the former England coach took control of the side in January.
Australia, who relied on their overseas-based players against Macedonia, have won eight of their last 11 games.
The Socceroos face Hungary in Budapest on April 2 in another friendly as part of their preparations for the World Cup Oceania group qualifiers, starting in June.
